info.title: Review Aftersales
info.description: API used to review (approve, reject, or offer alternatives to) a buyer's return request.

post.description: API used to review (approve, reject, or offer alternatives to) a buyer's return request.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

request_id.description: Identifies the object upon which this decision is made.

request_id_type.description:
Type of identifier provided in request_id.
Possible values:
- `AFTERSALES`
- `RMA`

return_line_item_id.description: Unique identifier for this item in the return. In the case of virtual bundle, this corresponds to the id of the original parent item bundle.

sub_return_line_item_id.description: Unique identifier for this item in the return. In the case of virtual bundle, this corresponds to the id of the current child item being returned.

line_items.description: Line items for which this decision applies. Decision details apply to each line item individually (e.g. a partial refund amount of $1.00 for 3 line items will result in a total partial refund amount of $3.00).

action.description:
Action/decision to be applied.
Possible values:
- `APPROVE_REQUEST`
- `APPROVE_RETURN_PACKAGE`
- `REJECT_REQUEST`
- `REJECT_RETURN_PACKAGE`
- `REFUND_INSTEAD`
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND`
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`

currency.description: Currency of the refund amount (ISO 4217). Must match the currency of the forward order.

alternative_solution_details.description: Details for an alternative resolution (if applicable).

reason_id.description:
Seller's reason for rejecting the aftersales request. Use the [Get Decision Eligibility](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/69844a11eeba77049695c7f6) endpoint to retrieve the currently available rejection options for the same request, and submit the returned rejection reason name in this field.
**Note**: The available decisions and rejection reasons can change depending on the current request status, so fetch eligibility again before calling this API.

uri.description: Image URI obtained from the [Upload Product Image](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509df95defece02be598a22) API.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the media (such as image/jpeg).

reason.description: To justify the action/decision (generally required for rejection).

line_item_decisions.description: Decisions applied at the line item level.

action_unix_time.description: The timestamp at which the decision/action was made (in unix seconds).

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize the same request. How you create unique keys is up to you, but we suggest using UUIDs, or another random string with enough entropy to avoid collisions. Idempotency keys can be up to 255 characters long.

aftersales_request_decisions.description: Decisions to apply to aftersales requests.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

message.example: Invalid parameters. Please verify your input before retrying

errors.description:
Lists errors for partially failed requests. For example, if a request reviews multiple orders or items and only some fail, individual error details are returned here.

**IMPORTANT**: Partial failures still return a top-level success code (0), so clients must also check this field to detect partial errors. For complete failures (e.g. validation errors), the top-level response code and message will indicate a failure, but this field will remain empty.
